edges.reason: VerseBooks721 constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, making the deployer the privileged owner.
onlyOwner compares the stored owner against msg.sender as the sole authorization check.
_mint records _creator[tokenId] = msg.sender, so the caller controls creator attribution.
_burn requires msg.sender == ownerOf(tokenId) before destroying the token.
setApprovalForAll keys operator approvals on _msgSender(), the caller-controlled address.
_msgSender() is forwarded as the operator argument into the receiver hook call.
Caller address is passed into the external onERC721Received call on an untrusted contract.
Only the owner modifier path can reach ownerTransfership state mutation.
createCollectible calls verifySign before performing any minting.
createCollectible calls _safeMint for the newly derived token id.
createCollectible stores the token URI after minting.
burn delegates the destruction logic to _burn.
_safeMint performs the actual mint through _mint.
_safeMint validates the recipient through _checkOnERC721Received after minting.
Three-argument safeTransferFrom forwards to the four-argument overload.
safeTransferFrom requires the caller to be approved or the owner before transferring.
safeTransferFrom invokes _safeTransfer to move the token.
transferFrom requires _isApprovedOrOwner on the caller before transferring.
transferFrom calls the internal _transfer routine.
_safeTransfer moves ownership via _transfer before the receiver check.
_safeTransfer requires a successful receiver hook result.
_isApprovedOrOwner requires the token to exist before authorization.
_isApprovedOrOwner reads the current owner to compare with the spender.
approve reads the current owner of the token.
approve writes the approval through _approve.
_transfer clears any outstanding approval while moving the token.
_burn clears the token approval before removal.
ERC721 constructor registers the supported interfaces.
functionCallWithValue requires the target to be a contract via isContract.
functionCallWithValue routes the raw return data through _verifyCallResult.
functionStaticCall requires the target to be a contract.
functionStaticCall verifies the static call result.
functionDelegateCall requires the target to be a contract.
functionDelegateCall verifies the delegatecall result.
functionCall with message forwards to functionCallWithValue with zero value.
Default-message functionCall forwards to functionCallWithValue.
Default-message functionStaticCall forwards to the message variant.
Default-message functionDelegateCall forwards to the message variant.
sendValue validates the low-level call success before continuing.
_setTokenURI writes the per-token URI mapping.
tokenURI reads the per-token URI mapping.
tokenURI reads the base URI prefix when composing metadata.
_setBaseURI writes the base URI prefix state variable.
royaltyFee reads the royalty mapping for the requested token.
getCreator reads the creator mapping for the requested token.
_mint writes the creator address into _creator.
_mint writes the supplied fee into _royaltyFee.
_mint registers the new owner in the _tokenOwners map.
_mint adds the token id to the recipient holder set.
_burn removes the token id from the previous holder set.
_burn removes the token id from the owner registry.
_transfer removes and adds the token in the respective holder sets.
_transfer updates the owner registry to the new owner.
_approve writes the approved operator into _tokenApprovals.
getApproved reads the _tokenApprovals mapping.
setApprovalForAll writes the operator flag in _operatorApprovals.
isApprovedForAll reads the operator flag from _operatorApprovals.
balanceOf returns the length of the holder token set.
totalSupply returns the length of the owner registry.
tokenByIndex reads a global entry from the owner registry.
tokenOfOwnerByIndex reads a holder entry from the holder set.
createCollectible increments tokenCounter by one after each successful mint.
Local newItemId is assigned from the tokenCounter state variable.
sendValue performs a low-level value call to a caller supplied recipient address.
functionCallWithValue performs a low-level call with value to an arbitrary target and data.
functionDelegateCall executes arbitrary target code in the current storage context.
functionStaticCall performs a read-only external call to an arbitrary target.
_checkOnERC721Received performs the external onERC721Received call on an untrusted recipient.
verifySign authenticates the mint request through ecrecover against the stored owner.
isContract relies on inline assembly extcodesize for contract detection.
A malicious receiver can re-enter the mint path through the receiver hook before state is finalized.
The receiver hook can re-enter burn logic while the transfer bookkeeping is unfinished.
The receiver hook can re-enter the internal transfer routine during a safe transfer.
Local newItemId is returned to the caller of createCollectible.
The tokenURI argument is minted and stored as the token metadata.
The tokenURI argument is hashed inside verifySign for signature recovery.
The sign struct v, r and s values are consumed by ecrecover in verifySign.
Local hash is used to build the signed message digest inside verifySign.
The fee argument is forwarded to the mint path as the royalty value.
The tokenId argument selects the token to be burned by burn.
The tokenId parameter identifies the token being destroyed in _burn.
The cached owner local is used for holder removal and the Transfer event in _burn.
The newOwner argument becomes the privileged owner of the contract.
The recipient parameter is the target of the low-level value call in sendValue.
The amount parameter is the native value forwarded in sendValue.

normalization_plan.reason: The burn token id parameter only has meaning as the argument of the burn entrypoint.
The new owner argument is consumed solely by ownerTransfership to change privileged ownership.
The URI argument flows directly into createCollectible minting and verification.
The fee argument is only used by createCollectible when minting the token.
The signature struct is passed from createCollectible into verifySign for ecrecover.
The local newItemId is derived from tokenCounter inside createCollectible and returned there.
The local hash exists only within verifySign to build the signed digest.
The _burn token id parameter is used only by the internal burn routine.
The cached owner local is scoped to the _burn bookkeeping and event emission.
The recipient parameter exists only as the target of the sendValue low-level call.
The amount parameter exists only as the value forwarded by sendValue.
